name: quick_burst_then_person
description: Just talk: a 0.6 s cup clink (-42 dB) opens the shared defer window, so Person 1's onset 1.2 s later latches the room at its first frame. The floor is measured on the clink, not on that onset: Person 1 (Muse 0.9 s late) is near, defers the icebreaker and keeps their turn.

turns.text: Hi, is this seat taken or can I sit here for a bit before the talk?
Go for it, I am just waiting for the next session to start here.
